ranked.title: Cross-strategy collapse-adjusted leak profile
ranked.problem: A method can look robust to ZeroThink/LessThink only because those prompts collapse; robustness must be reported net of collapse.
ranked.diff: Existing LRM-unlearning tables report per-strategy leak rates without conditioning on whether the strategy's own output survived; none report the collapse-adjusted profile.
ranked.method: Report, for every strategy, leak | clean (reached & non-degenerate & no echo), together with the collapse rate that produced it.
ranked.crossval: Hy4 reviews the pair (raw, adjusted) for this repository's numbers; a second reader recomputes from the CSV.
ranked.experiment: Existing baseline panels; no new generation.
ranked.expected: DefaultCoT 1.000 vs SummaryThink 0.364 adjusted, ordering unchanged but gaps shrink.

ranked.title: Censoring-required reporting (interval, not point)
ranked.problem: Point-estimate leak rates are uninterpretable when truncation is 90%+; the interval width is the honest unit of uncertainty.
ranked.diff: No LRM-unlearning table ships a censoring interval for evaluator truncation.
ranked.method: Right-censor truncated samples, clamp the upper bound to 1.0, publish [lo, hi] next to every point estimate.
ranked.crossval: Hy4 checks that the interval definition is a valid probability interval and that the width is reported for the same n as the point estimate.

ranked.title: Judge-failure-aware AFE (denominator policy)
ranked.problem: AFE silently changes when judge calls fail: the denominator shrinks and the surviving calls are not a random sample of rows.
ranked.diff: AFE is reported without a failure policy; no repo states whether failed calls are dropped, retried, or counted as non-leak.
ranked.method: Report AFE under three policies (drop, retry, worst-case) and the failure rate.
ranked.crossval: Hy4 compares the three policies for the same judged rows; the three numbers must be recomputable from one label file.
ranked.experiment: Uses the AFE label cache from the baseline run.
ranked.expected: failure 7.5-15%, so the policy spread is material.

ranked.title: Coverage gate for forget claims
ranked.problem: A forgetting claim is vacuous when the answer channel is never reached: 0 leak at coverage 0.05 means 'did not answer', not 'forgot'.
ranked.diff: Coverage is not reported in LRM-unlearning result tables; refusal is conflated with unreachability.
ranked.method: Require answer_reached_rate >= 0.5 per strategy before a leak rate may be read as forgetting; otherwise mark unevaluable.
ranked.crossval: Hy4 verifies the gate uses the same rows as the leak rate and that failing systems are marked, not dropped.

ranked.title: Leak-span localisation beyond substring match
ranked.problem: Substring matching cannot say where or how much a response leaks; a single echoed name and a full biographical sentence count the same.
ranked.diff: Existing metrics are binary per response; the judge already emits a verbatim span but no work aggregates span length/position into the metric.
ranked.method: Aggregate judge leak spans: span length in tokens, position relative to </think>, and the share of leaks that are entity-only.
ranked.crossval: Hy4 reviews a sample of spans against their responses and flags any span that does not quote the response verbatim.
ranked.experiment: Uses the AFE label cache (spans stored).
ranked.expected: most LEAK spans are the bare entity name.

ranked.title: State-consistent paired replay across strategies
ranked.problem: Per-strategy leak rates are not paired; a strategy difference may come from different question subsets reaching different states.
ranked.diff: No LRM-unlearning work reports per-question state invariance across decoding paths.
ranked.method: For each question, compare the state label across the four strategies; report the share of questions whose state is not invariant.
ranked.crossval: Hy4 checks the pairing key (question text) and that the same question set is used.
ranked.expected: DefaultCoT collapses while ZeroThink does not, so non-invariance is large.

ranked.title: Utility-vs-forgetting Pareto gate
ranked.problem: A method can buy leakage reduction with utility: retain ROUGE falls 0.55 -> 0.42 while the leak metric reports success.
ranked.diff: Utility is reported as a separate column; no gate ties the forgetting claim to a utility floor on the same rows.
ranked.method: Two-dimensional gate: claim admissible only if leak drops AND retain ROUGE stays within 0.05 of the pre-unlearning value.
ranked.crossval: Hy4 checks the floor is computed from the same retain rows for both systems.

ranked.title: Contract-bound detector reproduction (threshold + backend + data hash)
ranked.problem: Inference-time unlearning results are not reproducible because the detector threshold, judge backend and data version are unbound.
ranked.diff: REDaCT/ARIA report efficacy; none bind the detector contract, so a re-run silently changes the flagging rate.
ranked.method: Ship a contract file (threshold, backend, dataset hash, weights hash) and fail the run if any element differs.
ranked.crossval: Hy4 reviews the contract fields against the repository files and flags any field that cannot be checked.

ranked.title: Channel-resolved leak rate on closed-think rows only
ranked.problem: Answer-level leakage hides trace-level leakage; but a trace metric computed on rows without a closing tag is structurally zero.
ranked.diff: Existing channel metrics do not gate on 'the trace closed', so zero gaps are often artifacts.
ranked.method: Compute cot-vs-answer gap only on rows with a closed </think>, report the excluded share.
ranked.crossval: Hy4 checks that every counted row has a closing tag and that excluded rows are reported.
ranked.experiment: Computed on baseline DefaultCoT rows (32 closed).

ranked.title: Unlearning-induced state shift as the primary artefact
ranked.problem: Unlearning changes the generation distribution (collapse 0 -> 80%, truncation 8 -> 93%), so a before/after leak delta conflates forgetting with degeneration.
ranked.diff: Papers report leak deltas; none report the state-distribution shift that accompanies them.
ranked.method: Report the state mix before/after and require the delta to be decomposed into a state-shift component and a within-state component.
ranked.crossval: Hy4 recomputes the decomposition from the same rows and checks the components sum to the observed delta.
ranked.expected: state shift explains essentially all of the 0.87 delta.

ranked.title: Refusal-vs-collapse separation in AFE
ranked.problem: AFE = 1 - LEAK includes COLLAPSE as success, so a method that destroys the model scores as well as one that refuses cleanly.
ranked.diff: AFE has no collapse penalty in the headline number; REFUSE and COLLAPSE are pooled.
ranked.method: Report AFE_refuse = share of REFUSE among non-leak rows, and a collapse-penalised AFE.
ranked.crossval: Hy4 checks the label counts and that the adjusted AFE is monotone in collapse.

ranked.title: Score-free know-check as an evaluation precondition
ranked.problem: A leak rate is meaningless if the checkpoint never knew the split; but current pipelines assume knowledge and never test it.
ranked.diff: No benchmark ships a know-check gate; failures are diagnosed post hoc (our own case).
ranked.method: Before scoring, require teacher-forced NLL and greedy reproduction to agree that the split is known; otherwise mark the split unevaluable.
ranked.crossval: Hy4 checks the thresholds were fixed before measurement and that both signals use the same prompt template.
ranked.experiment: NLL + reproduction already measured on two splits (they disagreed).
ranked.expected: NLL 1.885 vs reproduction 0.0 on forget01 -> gate blocks.
